tools.name: get_latest_reset
tools.description: The most recent verified Codex global reset and the most recent banked-reset sighting, with totals and data coverage. History from public monitoring signals maintained by Agenai.

tools.name: list_reset_events
tools.description: List recorded Codex events, newest first. type 'reset' = verified global resets, 'credits' = banked-reset sightings, 'all' = both.

tools.name: get_reset_stats
tools.description: Cadence statistics over the full recorded history: total verified resets, resets in the last 30/90 days, gap between resets (average/median/min/max days), monthly counts and announcement-time distribution (Asia/Shanghai). History only — not a prediction.
